permits.description: Indian citizens from outside Arunachal Pradesh need an ILP to enter the state. Apply online (eILP) before travel and carry a printed or digital copy with photo ID.

permits.reconfirm_note: Check validity period and fee on the portal when applying.

permits.reconfirm_note: Fees and permit categories are listed on the portal; reconfirm before travel.

permits.reconfirm_note: Check local travel advisories before visiting.

permits.reconfirm_note: Confirm the current application route and fee before travel.

permits.description: All non-native visitors need an entry permit for the islands listed in their itinerary. Apply online well in advance and book flights or ships only after approval.

permits.description: Foreign nationals need a Protected Area Permit for areas such as Nubra, Pangong, Tso Moriri and Dah-Hanu. Indian citizens have not needed a permit for these areas since August 2021 (reported).
